walkthroughSteps.body: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' has 2 open blockers.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Modal opens on the Blockers step — deductible + salvage cards, each expandable to the underlying item. Only Cancel in the footer.

walkthroughSteps.title: Pre-closure Checklist
walkthroughSteps.body: With no blockers, the modal skips straight here — 6 system-validated conditions (deductible, litigation, subrogation/salvage, reserves, payments, provider). All must show green before Continue enables.

Apply AC-05 — all 3 sections closed, all tasks done → on Overview, Close Claim is now active and the claim closure modal's Blockers step no longer shows a sections blocker

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Deductible + salvage blockers prevent section close
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: 'Property Damage — Warehouse & Forklift' (SEC-001) has an open deductible task and pending salvage. Clicking Close Section shows both blockers — no Continue button.

setup.description: SEC-001 mock data has hasOpenDeductible=true and hasActiveSalvage=true. No state overrides needed — blockers come from section flags.
